# Data Pipeline Assumptions Note 4

We assume that data pipeline handling of consumer interacts with idempotency; teams noted that staleness depends on retry and compaction, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that data pipeline handling of checkpoint interacts with transform; teams noted that throughput depends on materialize and orchestrator, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: data pipeline handling of partition interacts with streaming; teams noted that source depends on watermark and latency, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that data pipeline handling of lineage interacts with shard; teams noted that dedupe depends on ingestion and offset, especially under real production load.
